supplemental_items.interpretation: Initial None builds once; materialize OA45 outside try and before audit. Under local context eagerly convert all records and validate all, then stable sort only cross non-null and >confirmation. Map normalized identity to first (cross,confirmation) pair; differing pair rejects, equal allowed without geometry/price equality. Publish triple or False; False remains eager fallback. No local reset of initial view on audit invalidation.
